notes: very suddenly is divided as very for בְּפֶתַע (rule 30 fusion) and suddenly for פִּתְאֹם; taking both words as one indivisible rendering of all three morphemes was the competing reading.
In בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי the assimilated article takes the phrase's single the and the ordinal's agreement article is unrepresented (rules 12, 47).
